knowledges.detail: Core: Awareness of health and safety regulations, standards and guidance relevant to the occupation and the crane operator's role and responsibilities.
Core: Lifting industry regulations, guidance, manufacturer’s specifications, and employer’s guidance.
Core: Personal protective equipment (PPE): types and use.
Core: Methods of interpreting and extracting relevant information from lift plans, method statements, specifications site plans, operator’s manual and risk assessments.
Core: Purpose of workplace inductions, tools box talks and team briefings.
Core: Crane electronic read out systems: purpose and use.

Core: Crane inspection and examination  documentation requirements: data recording, documentation control, auditable records, insurance, warranty, or other protections, inspection and reporting forms.
Core: How own role contributes and impacts the wider team and project objectives.
Core: Awareness of issues, common symptoms and warning signs of stress, anxiety, and depression, plus where to go for help and the resources available.
Core: Awareness of environmental and sustainability regulations, how to use resources efficiently. Principles of Recycling, reuse, and safe disposal of waste.
Core: Employment types (self-employed and employed), small business startup principles, tax responsibilities, roles, and responsibilities.
Core: Verbal communication techniques.
Core: Team working techniques.
Core: Communication techniques for the movement and placement of loads: verbal commands, visual commands, hand signals and radio.
Core: Slinging techniques for the attachment of loads: fibre slings, chain slings  and specialist equipment - plate clamps, slippers, lifting beams, lifting cells, eye bolts and magnets.
Core: Principles of falls of rope and changing falls of rope.
Core: Principles and application techniques of SWL (safe working load) limits & WLL (working load limit).
Core: Crane operation site safety information: layout of site traffic plans, the working areas, exclusion zones and authorised passages for movement.
Core: Lifting accessory inspection: Function and methods of checks, inspections, and reporting forms procedures for lifting accessories.
Core: Reporting: importance and methods of reporting hazards and issues.

duties.dutyDetail: Work in compliance with occupational health and safety and environmental legislation, relevant regulations, and recognised industry guidance to ensure the health, safety and wellbeing of self and others always. Report in a timely manner any non-compliances to the appropriate person.
Deliver work in accordance with lift plans and specifications.
Communicate effectively with team members to coordinate lifting activities.
Take appropriate action to resolve problems and minimise disruptions to lifting operations during crane operations.
Keep accurate records of lifting activities, including equipment inspections, maintenance procedures, safety checks, incidents, and near misses.
Prepare the work area, checking it is safe and in accordance with method statements and risk assessments and implement the necessary control measures.
Sling and signal the movement of suspended loads during lifting operations.
Maintain a clear and tidy workspace and ensure that waste materials are disposed of in accordance with current legislation and sustainably.
Work to the programme, adapting to changes in schedule and requirements where necessary.
Conduct quality checks against specification and take remedial action where instructed.
Collaborate with stakeholders.
Conduct continuous professional development to maintain knowledge of current and future developments affecting the role.
Position, prepare and configure mobile crane lifting equipment in readiness to conduct lifting activities.
Conduct pre-operational checks on mobile cranes and lifting equipment to ensure they are in good working condition and meet safety standards.
Determine the appropriate lifting technique for mobile cranes following lift plans to meet specific work requirements.
Operate mobile cranes using controls to lift, lower, and manoeuvre loads.
Perform routine maintenance on mobile cranes.
Position, prepare and configure crawler crane lifting equipment in readiness to conduct lifting activities.
Conduct pre-operational checks on crawler cranes and lifting equipment to ensure they are in good working condition and meet safety standards.
Determine the appropriate lifting technique for crawler cranes following lift plans to meet specific work requirements.
Operate crawler cranes, using controls to lift, lower, and manoeuvre loads.
Perform routine maintenance on crawler cranes.
Prepare and configure tower crane lifting equipment in readiness to conduct lifting activities.
Conduct pre-operational checks on tower cranes and lifting equipment to ensure they are in good working condition and meet safety standards.
Determine the appropriate lifting technique for tower cranes following lift plans to meet specific work requirements.
Operate tower cranes, using controls to lift, lower, and manoeuvre loads.
Perform routine maintenance on tower cranes.
Prepare and configure overhead crane lifting equipment in readiness to conduct lifting activities.
Conduct pre-operational checks on overhead cranes and lifting equipment to ensure they are in good working condition and meet safety standards.
Determine the appropriate lifting technique for overhead cranes following lift plans to meet specific work requirements.
Operate overhead cranes, using controls to lift, lower, and manoeuvre loads.
Perform routine maintenance on overhead cranes.
